# cloptima_llm_prompt_template (Resource)

Manages a prompt template in the Cloptima prompt registry. Prompt content is managed as versions with cloptima_llm_prompt_version. Destroying the template archives it. A template archived outside Terraform is recreated on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_prompt_template" "customer_support" {
  name        = "customer-support-agent"
  description = "System and grounding prompts for Tier 1 customer support agent"
  owner       = "support-eng"
  app_id      = "customer-support-app"
  environment = "production"

  tags = [
    "support",
    "tier-1",
    "customer-facing"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Prompt template name. Must be unique, ignoring case, among active templates in the same environment.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Application ID this template belongs to.
- `description` (String) Description of the prompt's purpose.
- `environment` (String) Environment label. Activating a version of a template in the prod or production environment requires an approved prompt deployment release gate.
- `owner` (String) Team or person responsible for this prompt template.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for categorization.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID this template belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `current_version_id` (String) ID of the currently active prompt version.
- `id` (String) Prompt template ID.
- `status` (String) Template status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
